verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows AI drafting answers to inbound customer security questionnaires from the company's own controls and knowledge base, with a human review step. The closest item, Comply AI extracting answers from vendor documents (secureframe-docs-24), covers assessing third-party vendors, which is the opposite direction from a sales lead answering prospects. The Trust Center self-serve document sharing (secureframe-docs-32) is a different capability and does not answer questionnaires.
